_comment: Reference for every environment variable the hook client reads. These are normally set in the `env` block of .claude/settings.json (see examples/settings.json), not in a file — the hook does not read this JSON. It exists only as documentation.
COORD_URL: http://127.0.0.1:8787   (base URL of the coordination server)
COORD_TOKEN: shared-bearer-token    (must match the server's COORD_TOKEN; omit for open dev mode)
COORD_TIMEOUT: 0.5                   (per-request timeout in seconds; fail open past this)
COORD_ENABLED: 1                     (set to 0/false to disable the hook without editing settings.json)
COORD_ID_FILE: ~/.config/agent-coordinator/id   (where the persistent machine id is stored)
